title: CLARIN:EL Medieval and Early Modern Greek corpora (16th c. notarial registers and Cretan/Heptanesian literature)
notes: CLARIN:EL publishes a resource family of Medieval and Early Modern Greek resources (featured at clarin.gr/en/resource-of-the-month/greek-middle-ages-clarinel, 200), including 11 complete 16th-c. notarial registers of Cretan and Ionian notaries; the notarial-deeds corpus behind the handle above (resolves to inventory.clarin.gr/corpus/902, live) covers deeds by Katoimeris, Varagas, Farmakis, Alexakis, Vranianitis, Maras, Patsidiotis and Ioannis Olokalos — matching the harvested documents '(Alexakis)' and 'Olokalos notary documents (Crete, 1496-1543)'; sibling corpora contain Montselese's Evgena (1646) and Kapianos/Visvizis deed editions, matching the other origin strings of this 20-text cluster ('CLARIN:EL 1210' is the RQ harvest's internal resource id; corpora are TEI-compliant XML). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: University of the Aegean / Greek Language Centre / ILSP 'Athena' (CLARIN:EL infrastructure)
